fact: In a communique of 31 August 2026 the CNDP asked that all AI-produced content in the September 2026 elections be flagged, citing article 447-2 of the Penal Code and organic law 53-25, while Morocco has no dedicated AI law.
title: Maroc : l'émergence d'une exigence de transparence de l'IA sans loi IA
